scheme:
Manual depth-unit coding of every block of three lessons (A2 density experiment).

Coding scheme (see A2_density.md §1):
  A block is coded with
    units : the NEW depth units it introduces (short descriptions; prefix = unit type)
    alloc : how its words (after auto-removed certainty tags) split across functions, in %:
        c core      words that carry a new unit (definition, result, derivation step, number, critique...)
        i illus     worked numbers / instances that only confirm a unit already introduced
        r restate   repetition of content from this lesson or earlier lessons (recaps, refresh, summaries)
        n narr      narration of the book/source ("K1:62 says", "the text takes a position", coverage)
        h hist      historical colour (names, dates, anecdotes) not needed for any unit
        m meta      signposting, previews, "let's stop here", lesson-structure talk
        s scaf      scaffolding of basics below level 2.5 (school algebra, keystrokes, figure walk-throughs)
        d dup       figure captions / tables / charts that duplicate the prose
        e err       OCR errata
        p payload   JSON/code (scene3d, anim, chart, notebook) - interactive, not prose
        x practice  exercises (retrieval practice; valuable, but no new unit)
  Unit types: DEF definition, RES result, STEP derivation step carrying an assumption, LIM limit/validity,
  OOM order-of-magnitude anchor, TRD trade-off, MAP cross-domain mapping, CRT critique/error,
  OPS operational meaning, PRX practitioner fact, STR structural/epistemic insight.
